name: Invulnerable Animal Companion
body:
Your animal companion’s hide or body is unusually tough and resistant to damage.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Animal Companion.

Benefit(s): Your animal companion gains DR/magic. The amount of DR is equal to ½ your ranger level.
